name: Russian SFSR (1918–1925)
description: A red field with the gold Cyrillic initials 'РСФСР' in stylised lettering within a gold border in the upper hoist canton.
history: Flag of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic established by the All-Russian Central Executive Committee on 13 April 1918, with the sample designed by the graphic artist Sergey Chekhonin approved on 17 June 1918: a red banner with the republic's abbreviated name in the canton. The 1925 constitution of the RSFSR (23 March 1925) redefined the flag, and the lettering was simplified in the 1937 version.
